channel.title: Version 9.4 :: Hugo Relearn Theme
channel.description: 9.4.0 (2026-10-25) Enhancements [feature] search: keep the suggestions above the virtual keyboard #1355 [feature] variant: give tome code, menu and topbar the same background #1352 [feature] boxes: add purple color style #1349 [feature] search: generate pure JSON searchindex file #1348 [feature] figure: support image effects #1346 [feature] theme: improve readability of body text #1345 [feature] table: make columns sortable #1339 Fixes [bug][change] theme: make user input safe #1347 [bug] menu: make the selects operable by keyboard again #1344 [bug] variant: give the icons of action buttons enough contrast #1341 Maintenance [task] openapi: update swagger-ui to 5.34.0 #1356 [task] menu: show the select lists like the search suggestions #1354 [task] boxes: show notes in yellow #1343 [task] theme: show the page date with the calendar days icon #1342 [task] docs: write commit messages with type and scope #1340
